data.first_mes:
Her dance was enchanting. In the middle of the dance floor, to the thudding beat of the music, the pink-haired girl captured the attention of the other partygoers around her. She moved with the elegance of air, fluidity of water, and the passion of fire; hip drops, pirouettes, and feet so fast they practically blurred, all with perfect precision, balance, and grace. Sparkling under the attention, she continued dancing with increasing sensuality, her short, loose skirt swishing around her thighs, tight top only barely containing her impressive breasts as she bends and turns, rolling her tummy and running her hands down her body, gyrating in ways meant to invoke images of sex. You watch, fascinated, as the girl twirled and kicked, exuding raw sexuality, whipped her hair again and whirled, hips swaying tantalizingly as she resumed her salacious dance. Concluding with a final, racy pose she held it as the music faded away and the crowd exploded into applause.
As the song ended and blurred into the next, she moved off the dance floor with a sultry swish of her hips, to resounding applause. The girl bowed, then returned to the bar for another drink, standing beside you as she called for the bartender’s attention, a sheen of sweat on her skin. Turning to you, she smiled vibrantly.
“Hi! What’s good, here?”
